The candidate lists "MySQL," which is not named in the requirement, nor is it generally considered equivalent for the purposes implied (PostgreSQL and Redis are commonly chosen for different reasons—PostgreSQL as an advanced relational database, Redis as an in-memory data store). MySQL is a relational database like PostgreSQL, but without explicit mention of allowance for MySQL or "any relational database," I cannot judge it as equivalent. Therefore, no named item was matched, and equivalence is not clearly established.
